name: prompt_caching_apply_anthropic_cache_control
notes: Anthropic cache-marker placement ladder. pc_* helpers are verbatim copies of the real port's file-statics in prompt_caching_plan.c (direct linking is not clean: unrelated externs); the apply body is a faithful traced copy. Inputs are <native>|<prefix or '->'|<messages-json>. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, inputs avoid it): LIVE strips pre-existing cache_control markers idempotently before placing new ones; the C apply body has no strip pre-pass — pre-marked inputs would diverge. Also LIVE's string-content user path consults find_stable_prefix (empty registry in a fresh process, so both take the plain path).
